title: Inside one of the world’s few crash courses in conserving and caring for ancient papyrus manuscripts
description: Nine international scholars recently completed a unique ten-day papyrus conservation seminar at the University of Michigan, which offers specialized training in preserving ancient manuscripts from one of the largest collections in the Western Hemisphere.

title: At Vallathol Vidyapeetham, researchers huddle to decipher ancient scripts
description: Vallathol Vidyapeetham offers a Manuscriptology, Epigraphy and Palaeography course for adults aged 23-75 to decipher ancient scripts, with students from various professions and international universities.
